chapterInfo.content:
2
Nyankopɔn mmuaeɛ
1 # Yes 21.8 Mɛgyina m’ahwɛeɛ,
na mede me ho bɛsi aban so,
na masra mahwɛ asɛm ko a ɔbɛka akyerɛ me
ne deɛ mede bɛbua no wɔ me nkurobɔ no ho.
2Na AWURADE buaa me sɛ:
Twerɛ adehunu no,
na kyerɛkyerɛ mu gu aboɔpono so,
na wɔatumi akan no wɔ ahoɔherɛ so.
3 # 2 Pe 3.9 Na adehunu no da so kyerɛ berɛ a wɔahyɛ,
na ɛrepɛ kwan aba mu, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ nso.
Sɛ ɛtwentwɛn ase mpo a, twɛn no ara,
na ba deɛ, ɛbɛba, ɛrenka akyi.
4 # Yes 48.22; Rom 1.17; Gal 3.11; Heb 10.38 Hwɛ, ɔbɔnefoɔ kra huhuru,
ɛntene wɔ ne mu,
na ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɔnam ne nokorɛdie so na ɔbɛtena ase.
Nkonimdifoɔ no nnue!
5Na bio nso, Kaldeafoɔ te sɛ nsabofoɔ.
Na wɔyɛ nnipa ahokyerɛfoɔ a wɔn bo nnwo da;
wɔatrɛ wɔn kra akɔnnɔ mu sɛ Asamando,
na wɔte sɛ owuo a ɔmmeeɛ,
wɔfa amanaman nnommum ba wɔn nkyɛn
na wɔfom aman nyinaa fa.
6Ɛberɛ bi reba a wɔn nnomumfoɔ bɛsere na wɔadi wɔn ho fɛw sɛ:
Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔnam asisie kwan so fa adeɛ a ɛnyɛ ne dea no.
W’apoobɔ yi bɛkɔ so ara akɔsi da bɛn?
7Ɛnyɛ mpofirim na wɔn a wɔde wo ka bɛsɔreɛ atia wo,
na wɔbɛnyane na wɔabɛhwanyan woɔ,
na woadane wɔn asadeɛ?
8 # Hab 2.17 Ɛsiane sɛ woafom amanaman pii afa nti,
na woaka nnipa mogya agu, ne nhyɛsoɔ a wode ahyɛ asase,
nkuro ne emufoɔ nyinaa soɔ
nti aman mu nkaeɛ nyinaa bɛfom wo nso afa.
9Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔnya mfasoɔ bɔne ma ne fie,
sɛ ɔde ne pirebuo bɛsi sorɔnsorɔmmea
na wayi ne ho afiri mmusuo nsam no.
10Woatu agyina anya aniwuo ama wo fie,
sɛ woatwitwa aman pii aguo,
na woayɛ wo kra bɔne.
11Ɔboɔ firi ɔfasuo mu bɛteam,
na mpuna afiri nnua mu agye so.
12 # Yer 22.13; Mika 3.10 Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔkyekyere kuro mogya mu,
na ɔto aban abusudeɛ mu.
13 # Yer 51.58 Hwɛ, ɛmfiri asafo AWURADE nkyɛn
sɛ aman yɛ adwuma brɛ ma ogya,
na nkurɔfoɔ brɛ ma ade hunu?
14 # Yes 11.9 Na afei deɛ, AWURADE animuonyam ho nimdeɛ
bɛhyɛ asase so ma
sɛdeɛ nsuo kata ɛpo soɔ.
15Due, wo a woma wo yɔnko nsa nom
wɔ adwenbɔne kwan soɔ,
na woma no borɔ na woahwɛ n’adagya mu.
16 # Yer 25.15, 26 Ahohora amee wo asene animuonyam;
wo nso nom, na wo momonoto nna adi;
AWURADE nifa mu kuruwa
bɛdane aba wo so,
na ɛfeɛ ne ahohora bɛgu w’animuonyam so.
17Na wo Babel, asɛmmɔne a wɔde dii Lebanon
ne mmoa sɛeɛ a ɛbɔɔ wɔn binim no,
nnipa mogya a woaka aguo, ne nhyɛsoɔ a wode ahyɛ asase,
kuro ne emufoɔ nyinaa so no nyinaa bɛbua w’atifi.
18 # Yes 44.10 Sɛ odwumfoɔ sene ohoni a,
ɛho mfasoɔ ne deɛn?
Ɛyɛ guo honi, kyerɛkyerɛni torofoɔ;
ɛfiri sɛ odwumfoɔ yɛ ahoni mum a,
ɔde ne ho to ɔno ara n’adwinnie a ɔdie no so.
19 # Dwom 115.4-8 Due, wo a woka kyerɛ dua sɛ: Nyane!
Na woka kyerɛ ɔboɔ mum sɛ: Sɔre!
Ɛno na ɛbɛkyerɛ adeɛ anaa?
Hwɛ, wɔde sika ne dwetɛ adura ho,
na ahome biara nni mu.
20 # Dwom 11.4; 76.8; Sak 2.13; Adi 8.1 Na AWURADE deɛ, ɔwɔ n’asɔrefie kronkron mu;
na momma asase nyinaa nyɛ komm wɔ n’anim.

Na adehunu no da so kyerɛ berɛ a wɔahyɛ,

na wɔte sɛ owuo a ɔmmeeɛ,

Ɛberɛ bi reba a wɔn nnomumfoɔ bɛsere na wɔadi wɔn ho fɛw sɛ:
Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔnam asisie kwan so fa adeɛ a ɛnyɛ ne dea no.

Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔnya mfasoɔ bɔne ma ne fie,

Woatu agyina anya aniwuo ama wo fie,

Ɔboɔ firi ɔfasuo mu bɛteam,

Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔkyekyere kuro mogya mu,
na ɔto aban abusudeɛ mu.
Hwɛ, ɛmfiri asafo AWURADE nkyɛn

Na afei deɛ, AWURADE animuonyam ho nimdeɛ
bɛhyɛ asase so ma

Due, wo a woma wo yɔnko nsa nom

Ahohora amee wo asene animuonyam;
wo nso nom, na wo momonoto nna adi;

Sɛ odwumfoɔ sene ohoni a,
ɛho mfasoɔ ne deɛn?
Ɛyɛ guo honi, kyerɛkyerɛni torofoɔ;
ɛfiri sɛ odwumfoɔ yɛ ahoni mum a,
ɔde ne ho to ɔno ara n’adwinnie a ɔdie no so.

Na AWURADE deɛ, ɔwɔ n’asɔrefie kronkron mu;

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
